about: What each vendor offers for signing in: methods, passkeys, 2FA, linking and email change. Vendor facts only, each read on the vendor's own pages on the date in checked.

rows.name: Claude (claude.ai and the Claude Console)
rows.trap: Claude and Console accounts are separate even with one email, and the email cannot be changed: a new email means a new account.

rows.name: Google Antigravity
rows.trap: A Workspace account instead of the personal account holding AI Pro or Ultra gets only a starter quota.

rows.name: Apple Account
rows.trap: Security keys require registering at least two keys (up to six); keep spares so a lost key does not lock you out.

rows.name: Amazon Web Services (root and IAM users)
rows.trap: Register several MFA devices (up to eight) so a lost one does not force the account recovery procedure.

rows.name: Baseten
rows.trap: Once SSO is on, it is required for every sign-in to the organization, and addresses outside its domains cannot sign in.

rows.name: Blacksmith
rows.trap: Signing in with a different GitHub user silently creates a new Blacksmith account.

rows.name: CircleCI
rows.trap: MFA is required for email and password sign-ins; GitHub and Bitbucket sign-ins use that provider's MFA instead.

rows.name: Cloudflare dashboard
rows.trap: Changing the account email unlinks Apple login; signing in with that Apple ID afterward creates a new Cloudflare account.

rows.name: Google Colab
rows.trap: Paid Colab benefits stay on the Google Account that subscribed; another signed-in account shows the free tier.

rows.name: Comfy Cloud
rows.trap: SSO accounts cannot use the desktop app or accept workspace invite links yet; an admin must add them directly.

rows.name: Crusoe Cloud
rows.trap: Recovery codes work only as a supplement to a first MFA method.

rows.name: Devin
rows.trap: On the Teams plan an SSO connection signs in existing members only (no just-in-time provisioning), so people must be invited before their first SSO sign-in.

rows.name: DigitalOcean
rows.trap: GitHub sign-in needs the GitHub and DigitalOcean emails to match, so changing the GitHub email before the DigitalOcean one blocks GitHub login.

rows.name: Docker account (Docker Hub)
rows.trap: Continue with Google or GitHub under an email that differs from the Docker account creates a second account instead of linking.

rows.name: ElevenLabs
rows.trap: The one backup code is shown once and cannot be viewed again; it only removes 2FA, so store it during setup.

rows.name: GitHub
rows.trap: If you lose your 2FA credentials and recovery methods, GitHub Support cannot restore your account.

rows.name: Google Account
rows.trap: A newly added passkey or security key can take up to 7 days to become available at sign-in.

rows.name: Google AI Studio
rows.trap: A Workspace admin can turn AI Studio off for the account, and unusual activity blocks access until phone or billing verification.

rows.name: Google Cloud console
rows.trap: The Cloud and Firebase consoles block accounts without 2-Step Verification, even accounts with passkeys.

rows.name: Greptile
rows.trap: With Require SSO on, a password or Google session cannot reach the organization until you sign in through SSO.

rows.name: Hetzner
rows.trap: A lost 2FA recovery key is replaced only after Hetzner reviews and verifies your request by hand.

rows.name: Hugging Face
rows.trap: With 2FA on and no authenticator app, set one up or turn off 2FA before removing your last passkey.

rows.name: Intel Tiber AI Cloud
rows.trap: A new phone or device means you must reset Intel's multi-factor authentication.

rows.name: Google Jules
rows.trap: Paid plans work only for personal @gmail.com accounts, so a Workspace sign-in pushes people to a second account.

rows.name: Kilo Code
rows.trap: Signing in with a provider other than the one you signed up with is refused for the same email.

rows.name: Kiro
rows.trap: GitHub, Google or Builder ID sign-in makes you an individual subscriber, separate from organization sign-in through IAM Identity Center.

rows.name: Koyeb
rows.trap: The account email cannot be changed, so sign up with the address you plan to keep.

rows.name: Lambda Cloud
rows.trap: If your email already belongs to another Lambda Cloud account, contact your account manager before signing in with company SSO.

rows.name: Lightning AI
rows.trap: Personal emails can wait 2 to 3 business days for verification; the docs suggest a work email, which makes a second account.

rows.name: Microsoft account
rows.trap: Losing your only passkey could lock you out; Microsoft recommends passkeys in two storage locations, and is phasing out SMS for personal accounts.

rows.name: Modal
rows.trap: Require SSO can lock out an admin who has no access to the identity provider; confirm that access first.

rows.name: NVIDIA account (build.nvidia.com and NGC)
rows.trap: Log in with Apple or Google under another email makes a second, empty account; settings can only unlink providers.

rows.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
rows.trap: Lose your only 2-step device without a bypass code and an administrator, or live chat for Free Tier, must reset it.

rows.name: Proton Account
rows.trap: A security key is only a second step: you still enter your username and password first.

rows.name: Resend
rows.trap: A login's email cannot be changed, even by support; a lost mailbox means a new login re-invited by an admin.

rows.name: RunPod
rows.trap: CLI email-code sign-in with any address other than the account's exact email silently creates a new account.

rows.name: Saturn Cloud
rows.trap: Enterprise on AWS signs in through its own Saturn Cloud domain, not the hosted login.

rows.name: Tetrate Agent Router Service
rows.trap: New accounts start with Google or GitHub; email sign-in is for existing accounts only.

rows.name: Together AI
rows.trap: Sign in only with the provider used at signup; a different one gives an already-linked error, and email cannot be changed directly.

rows.name: Ubicloud
rows.trap: Sign-in asks for the email first, then shows only the methods set up for that account.

rows.name: Vast.ai
rows.trap: Lose your phone with no recovery codes and only Vast support can restore access; legacy SMS 2FA has no codes.

rows.name: Zed
rows.trap: Zed account email is copied from GitHub; billing in Stripe does not update automatically when it changes.
